title: dsh-passwords 2.7.7: the password gate provides tracyAssertion again, so the tabs plugin records a turn's moment and the tools plugin signs the person who typed
steps: S1: In vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords run: npm ci
S2: In vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords run: node --import tsx --test --test-timeout=120000 test/tracy/assertion.test.ts
S3: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: 'a signed assertion lives sixty seconds and names the lower-cased address' passes.
'an address that is not one is never signed' passes.
'what this gate signs, tracy-web accepts; another secret or an expired one it refuses' passes: tracy-web's own verifyActor accepts the token.
'the service is provided as `tracyAssertion` when the fleet secret is set, and not at all when it is not' passes.
'the plugin entry provides it from the fleet secret, outside the "gateway configured" branch' passes.

tests: a signed assertion lives sixty seconds and names the lower-cased address
an address that is not one is never signed
what this gate signs, tracy-web accepts
the service is provided as `tracyAssertion` when the fleet secret is set
the plugin entry provides it from the fleet secret
